wiki.title: Cathy Tilton
wiki.extract: Cathy Tilton (born August 28, 1962) is an American politician from Alaska. A Republican, she represents District M in the Alaska Senate. Previously she was Speaker of the Alaska House of Representatives from 2023 to 2025, and represented District 26 which is entirely within the Matanuska-Susitna Borough. Prior to 2020 redistricting, represented District 12.
